# Risks, open decisions and postponed scope

| Risk | Impact | Mitigation | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Regulator onboarding slower than planned | HIGH | Start applications in P1; India launch path does not depend on UAE integrations | P5 |
| AI note quality or clinician trust too low | HIGH | Evaluation set in CI, opt-in pilot, manual note always available, clear evidence links | P3 |
| Single developer bandwidth | HIGH | Strict phase scope freeze, overlapping only pilots, postponed infrastructure list | All |
| Legacy data varies per clinic | MED | Dry-run report before sign-off, fix-by-rule queue, reusable mapping templates | P5 |
| Consent and data-protection rules change | MED | Consent model versioned; legal review per data class; DPDP phased timeline tracked | P1+ |
| Payment gateway and WhatsApp approvals delayed | MED | Apply during P2; cash and SMS paths work without them | P4 |
| Double booking or wrong-patient errors | HIGH | Database constraints, identity hard stops, concurrency tests in every release | P1+ |
| Always Encrypted limits queries on protected columns | MED | Deterministic encryption for exact ID lookups, VBS enclaves for range/LIKE; keep the protected set small | P0 |
| Database cost as clinics grow | MED | Elastic pools for pooled clinics, serverless for non-production, monthly cost review | P5 |
| AI model not available in-region | MED | Confirm region per model in P0; abstraction in AI worker to switch provider | P3 |

## Open decisions

| Decision | Due | Default if not decided |
|---|---|---|
| Launch market: India or a UAE emirate first? | P0 wk 1 | India first for the pilot; UAE pack built in P5 while regulator onboarding runs |
| Confirm stack (ADR-001) | P0 wk 1 | Decided in v2: .NET 10 + React/MUI + Azure SQL Database |
| Azure SQL tier at launch | P0 wk 2 | Serverless for dev/staging; General Purpose provisioned with zone redundancy for production; Business Critical for hospital stamps |
| Pricing model (per doctor, per clinic, AI add-on) | P4 start | Per doctor per month, AI notes included in higher plan |
| AI provider and regions | P2 end | Azure OpenAI + Azure AI Speech in-region |
| Wearable hardware partner | P5 end | Defer until phone capture metrics are met |
| Teleconsultation earlier than P8? | P4 review | Keep in P8 unless two paying clinics require it |

## Out of scope until clinical and regulatory evidence exists

- AI diagnosis or autonomous triage
- Complex agent orchestration with broad record access
- Full hospital inventory and ERP
- Insurance claims beyond eligibility, pre-auth and remittance
- Wearables beyond the Medvya clip
- Microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL, Elasticsearch before P7

> Hosting on Azure does not make Medvya compliant by itself. Qualified legal and clinical review in each market is required before real patient records are processed (P1 for demographics, P2 for clinical data, P3 for audio).
